description: SmartDesk FAQ Semantic Search & Retrieval Evaluation Benchmark

faqs.question: What are the semester tuition fee payment deadlines and late penalty fees?
faqs.answer: Semester fees must be remitted by September 15 for odd semesters and February 15 for even semesters. A late fine of INR 500 applies for the first 7 days, increasing to INR 1,500 until the final cutoff date.

faqs.question: What should I do if money was deducted from my bank but the fee portal shows unpaid?
faqs.answer: Bank gateway transactions typically reconcile within 24 to 48 banking hours. If the status does not update, submit a ticket with your transaction reference ID and bank debit statement.

faqs.question: How do I apply for an official sealed academic transcript for higher studies?
faqs.answer: Transcripts can be requested through the Student Portal under Academic Services. Normal processing takes 5 working days, while expedited processing takes 48 hours for visa verification.

faqs.question: What is the procedure to correct student or parent name spelling on marksheet?
faqs.answer: Submit a ticket to the Academic Registrar with a copy of your Class 10/12 government matriculation certificate and Aadhaar card for name correction.

faqs.question: How do I report an examination timetable clash between two registered courses?
faqs.answer: Report timetable conflicts to the Controller of Examinations at least 7 days before commencement using the exam conflict form with course codes.

faqs.question: What is the fee and timeline for end-semester paper revaluation?
faqs.answer: Revaluation requests must be filed within 10 days of results announcement. Fee is INR 750 per paper. Answer scripts are independently evaluated by senior faculty.

faqs.question: What is the hostel night curfew timing and night-out pass procedure?
faqs.answer: Hostel gates close at 10:00 PM on weekdays and 10:30 PM on weekends. Night-out leave passes require parental approval via registered SMS/app 6 hours in advance.

faqs.question: How do I lodge a hostel room electrical, plumbing or carpentry repair complaint?
faqs.answer: Room maintenance requests must be logged on the SmartDesk maintenance portal or register book in the warden's office. Standard repair SLA is 24 hours.

faqs.question: How do I register a new laptop MAC address for campus WiFi?
faqs.answer: Connect to 'Campus-Onboarding' network and visit http://wifi.college.edu to enter your student credentials and device MAC address. Max 3 devices permitted.

faqs.question: How do I reset my institutional college email and student ERP password?
faqs.answer: Use the self-service password reset page with your registered mobile OTP, or visit the Central IT Helpdesk on Ground Floor, Admin Block with your student ID.

faqs.question: How do I access IEEE, ScienceDirect and ACM digital libraries from off-campus?
faqs.answer: Access digital databases through the remote library proxy portal at https://elibrary.college.edu using your college LDAP credentials or university VPN.

faqs.question: What are the library overdue fine rates and maximum book borrowing limits?
faqs.answer: Undergraduates can borrow up to 4 books for 14 days. Overdue fines are INR 5 per day per book for the first week and INR 10 per day thereafter.

faqs.question: How do day-scholar students apply for or renew college bus passes?
faqs.answer: Bus pass applications open 15 days before each semester on the Transport Portal. Submit route choice, passport photo, and receipt of transport fee payment.

faqs.question: Where can students obtain campus two-wheeler and four-wheeler vehicle parking stickers?
faqs.answer: Parking stickers are issued by Campus Security Office at Gate 1 upon presenting valid driving license, vehicle RC copy, and college ID card.

faqs.question: What is the procedure to get an Internship No Objection Certificate (NOC)?
faqs.answer: Submit company offer letter, duration details, and job role to the Department Placement Faculty Coordinator. Approved NOC is issued within 3 working days.

faqs.question: What are the minimum eligibility rules for campus placement recruitment drives?
faqs.answer: Students must have minimum 60% or 6.5 CGPA with zero active backlogs at the time of drive. Individual companies may set higher cutoffs.

faqs.question: What should I do if I lose my physical student ID card?
faqs.answer: File a lost item declaration at security desk, pay INR 250 duplicate card fee at Accounts, and submit receipt to Student Affairs for a replacement smartcard.

faqs.question: How can students report ragging, harassment, or severe personal grievances?
faqs.answer: Contact the 24/7 Anti-Ragging Helpline at 1800-180-5522 or email antiragging@college.edu. Complaints can also be submitted confidentially on SmartDesk.

faqs.question: What documents are required for National Scholarship Portal (NSP) verification?
faqs.answer: Upload income certificate, domicile certificate, previous year marksheet, fee receipt, bank passbook copy, and bonafide certificate for nodal officer verification.

faqs.question: What is the minimum CGPA required to retain merit-cum-means tuition fee scholarship?
faqs.answer: Recipients must maintain a minimum CGPA of 7.50 without any backlog papers and minimum 75% attendance in each semester for automatic scholarship renewal.
